title: Task Contract
description: The complete worker-specific specification the root/current parent Director must provide before delegating any task. It includes an explicitly assigned non-Director role, worker goal, scope/non-goals, success/failure/termination criteria, required evidence, model policy, and conflict domains.

objective.description: Why this task exists — the purpose of the work.

goal.description: The concrete goal assigned to this specific worker; it is not inferred from the overall objective.

current_state.description: Observed state of the code or behavior before this task.

target_behavior.description: Precise description of the behavior after the task is done.

must_read_files.description: Files the worker must read before changing anything.

editable_files.description: Files or globs the worker is allowed to modify or create.

forbidden_files.description: Files or globs the worker must not touch.

interfaces_to_preserve.description: Public functions, endpoints, CLI flags, schemas, or contracts that must remain unchanged.

input_format.description: Expected input shape. Use 'n/a' when not applicable.

output_format.description: Expected output shape. Use 'n/a' when not applicable.

error_handling.description: Error situations that must be handled, and how.

preservation_conditions.description: Existing behavior that must not regress.

completion_criteria.description: Objective, checkable conditions that define done.

success_criteria.description: Objective conditions this worker must satisfy; worker-specific and not a substitute for completion_criteria.

failure_criteria.description: Worker-specific conditions that require reporting failure or stopping.

termination_criteria.description: Worker-specific conditions for stopping the assignment without further edits or tests.

required_evidence.description: Evidence and deliverables the worker must return to the parent Director.

test_commands.description: Exact commands the worker must run and report results for.

manual_verification.description: Manual verification steps when automation is insufficient. May be empty.

role.description: The explicitly assigned non-Director worker role, recorded before spawn. The role name director is invalid; only the root/current parent session is Director. Rescue is a task-scoped implementer promotion.

model.description: The worker model selected by adapter policy or explicit user policy.

model_ceiling.description: The maximum worker model allowed by the active adapter policy.

reasoning_effort.description: The selected reasoning effort for this contract.

execution.description: Whether this task is dispatched concurrently or in dependency order.

justification.description: A concrete reason this task needs a separate worker rather than being folded into another contract.

spawn_authority.description: Only the director may spawn a delegated worker.

delegation.description: The worker role, model policy, effort, execution mode, justification, and spawn authority disclosed before dispatch.

depends_on.description: Task IDs that must be reviewed before this task starts.

conflict_domains.description: Resources this task may read or write. Any overlap with an in-flight task forces sequential execution.
